name: Ranna
title: Furrier of the Hidehall
examine: She can grade a pelt through a shut door. She grades people the same way, and most of us are second quality on a good day.
lines: First quality goes south. Second quality goes on your back. There is no third quality, there is the midden.
Bring me winter fur, not summer scruff.
The grade is the grade. Shout if it helps you.
